snippet.title: Yudi J - NRI Personal Finance
snippet.description:
Moving to the U.S. changes a lot about how you think about money.

You’re figuring out taxes, investing, credit, mortgages, retirement, sending money to India, and everything in between.

This channel makes that a little easier.

Hi - I’m Yudi Jagani. I came to the U.S. as an international student and have now spent 12+ years building my career and life here.
Along the way, I went through the F-1 to H-1B journey, built a career, started a business, bought a home, and started thinking seriously about financial independence.

I’m not a financial advisor. I’m sharing what I’ve personally learned, the mistakes I’ve made, and the frameworks that have helped me make better financial decisions.

My goal is simple: to help you make smarter money decisions in America so you can build more freedom for yourself and your family.
